reasons: The cited clause 2.2 makes Vendor the 'sole and exclusive provider' of hosted analytics services for the full term with no category limit, time limit, or performance-based exit — squarely the EXCLUSIVITY walk-away scenario, so the deviation status is correct.

The redline deletes p0013 in full, which implements the preferred position (no exclusivity binding Customer) and removes no exclusivity that would benefit Customer; deletion is the minimal edit that reaches the preferred position.
Deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and no residual sole-supplier/requirements obligation on Customer remains.

The comment accurately explains the deletion, cites the playbook position, correctly notes the conflict with clause 2.1's no-minimum-commitment language, and offers the category-limited 12-month fallback with an automatic service-level/delivery exit; tone and prefix conform.
